description: This file defines the LockingSessionConnection class, which extends StandardSessionConnection, and adds locking logic to read operations in AWS DynamoDB context.

classes.name: LockingSessionConnection
classes.description: A class extending StandardSessionConnection that implements locking logic for DynamoDB read operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LockingSessionConnection with a DynamoDbClient and configuration array.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock and read an item from DynamoDB, retrying until the lock is obtained or timeout occurs.
